content.biome.chip-canyons.desc: Cliffs of stacked potato chips. Crabs scuttle in the cracks.
content.biome.chip-canyons.name: Chip Canyons
content.biome.coin-laundromat.desc: Rows of washers hum in an empty field. Nobody knows who pays the power bill.
content.biome.coin-laundromat.name: Coin Laundromat
content.biome.compost-caves.desc: Damp tunnels under the compost heap. Spore vents sting.
content.biome.compost-caves.name: Compost Caves
content.biome.crop-circle.desc: Wheat pressed flat in perfect rings. Something landed here and left its crew behind.
content.biome.crop-circle.name: Crop Circle
content.biome.frozen-tundra.desc: A frozen plain of fries. Frost patches chill Tibo.
content.biome.frozen-tundra.name: Frozen-Fries Tundra
content.biome.fry-oil-desert.desc: Hot sand and pools of fryer oil that burn.
content.biome.fry-oil-desert.name: Fry-Oil Desert
content.biome.fry-palace.desc: A drive-thru alone in the wild, still open. Gulls and raccoons rule the parking lot.
content.biome.fry-palace.name: Fry Palace Drive-Thru
content.biome.gutterball-lanes.desc: A bowling alley with no walls and no roof. The lanes are still oiled and the pins still stand.
content.biome.gutterball-lanes.name: Gutterball Lanes
content.biome.ketchup-bog.desc: A hot red marsh. Puddles of ketchup burn and slow.
content.biome.ketchup-bog.name: Ketchup Bog
content.biome.mash-swamp.desc: Knee-deep mashed potato. It slows Tibo down.
content.biome.mash-swamp.name: Mash Swamp
content.biome.peel-forest.desc: Trees with bark like potato peel. Thorny brambles scratch.
content.biome.peel-forest.name: Peel Forest
content.biome.potato-field.desc: Neat rows of potato plants. Where every run starts.
content.biome.potato-field.name: Potato Field
content.boss.amusing.desc: The potato festival's fluffy pink mascot. He waves hello, throws hearts and stuffing, then leaps in for a hug that squeezes the starch out of you.
content.boss.amusing.name: amusing
content.boss.amusing.title: The Festival Mascot
content.boss.beetle-queen.desc: The striped potato beetle queen. Her brood hatches in a ring around Tibo.
content.boss.beetle-queen.name: Colorado Queen
content.boss.beetle-queen.title: Mother of Beetles
content.boss.compost-titan.desc: A heap of rotting leaves and mulch. Maggots pour out of it.
content.boss.compost-titan.name: Compost Titan
content.boss.compost-titan.title: The Rot Heap
content.boss.deep-freezer.desc: A walking chest freezer. It fires ice shards that slow.
content.boss.deep-freezer.name: The Deep Freezer
content.boss.deep-freezer.title: Keeper of Frozen Fries
content.boss.fryer-king.desc: A crowned deep fryer. It spits rings of boiling oil.
content.boss.fryer-king.name: The Fryer King
content.boss.fryer-king.title: Lord of the Hot Oil
content.boss.grater-golem.desc: A box grater on legs. It charges along a marked line.
content.boss.grater-golem.name: Grater Golem
content.boss.grater-golem.title: The Shredder
content.boss.great-wireworm.desc: A huge wireworm. It burrows and bursts up under Tibo.
content.boss.great-wireworm.name: The Great Wireworm
content.boss.great-wireworm.title: Borer of Tubers
content.boss.harvester.desc: A combine harvester. It charges down long lanes. Every potato's last fear.
content.boss.harvester.name: The Harvester
content.boss.harvester.title: End of the Season
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.desc: A kraken of ketchup. Its tentacles slam down in a pattern.
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.name: Ketchup Kraken
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.title: Terror of the Bog
content.boss.late-blight.desc: A creeping cloud of blight. Spore clouds bloom where it points.
content.boss.late-blight.name: Late Blight
content.boss.late-blight.title: The Famine Fog
content.boss.sir-strawman.desc: A scarecrow knight. It throws fans of sharp straw.
content.boss.sir-strawman.name: Sir Strawman
content.boss.sir-strawman.title: Guardian of the Rows
content.boss.the-mandoline.desc: A living mandoline slicer. Its blade sweeps across in lanes.
content.boss.the-mandoline.name: The Mandoline
content.boss.the-mandoline.title: Slicer of Fries
content.boss.the-masher.desc: A giant potato masher. It slams where Tibo stands.
content.boss.the-masher.name: The Masher
content.boss.the-masher.title: Kitchen Enforcer
content.botHelp.bubbler.desc: Wraps Tibo in a bubble for a moment and patches him up.
content.botHelp.bubbler.name: Bubble Bot
content.botHelp.gifter.desc: Drops a handful of coins, a gem worth part of a level, and now and then a Bot Beacon.
content.botHelp.gifter.name: Gift Bot
content.botHelp.tidier.desc: Sweeps every nearby gem and coin over to Tibo.
content.botHelp.tidier.name: Tidy Bot
content.botHelp.zapper.desc: Zaps the closest bugs. Elites only get a jolt, and bosses are too big to zap.
content.botHelp.zapper.name: Zapper Bot
content.dog.beagle.desc: Points to the nearest crate, shrine or dog, and finds loose gold.
content.dog.beagle.name: Scout
content.dog.collie.desc: Every few seconds, shoves the enemies around you back.
content.dog.collie.name: Moss
content.dog.corgi.desc: Barks every few seconds and freezes nearby enemies (not bosses).
content.dog.corgi.name: Waffles
content.dog.dachshund.desc: Digs up gold every few seconds, and sometimes a snack or a reroll.
content.dog.dachshund.name: Frank
content.dog.greyhound.desc: Every few seconds, sprints through a line of enemies and hurts them all.
content.dog.greyhound.name: Zoom
content.dog.pomchi.desc: Marks the nearest elite or loot runner so it takes more damage.
content.dog.pomchi.name: Zelda
content.dog.pomeranian.desc: His fluff takes the next hit on you, then he sneezes pests away.
content.dog.pomeranian.name: Link
content.dog.retriever.desc: Every few seconds, brings gems, gold and snacks to you from far away.
content.dog.retriever.name: Biscuit
content.dog.saint-bernard.desc: When your health drops low, runs to you and heals you.
content.dog.saint-bernard.name: Barrel
content.dog.terrier.desc: Darts at the nearest enemy and bites it, about once a second.
content.dog.terrier.name: Pip
content.dog.zelda-and-link.desc: Link's fluff and Zelda's marks, plus an eclipse that shields you and marks every pest near you.
content.dog.zelda-and-link.name: Zelda & Link

content.event.harvest-moon.announce: Harvest Moon: double gold for 30 s
content.event.harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
content.event.loose-change.announce: Loose change in the dryers: double gold for 20 s
content.event.loose-change.name: Loose Change
content.event.lost-saucer.announce: A lost saucer! Shoot it down for gold!
content.event.lost-saucer.name: Lost Saucer
content.event.lunch-rush.announce: Lunch rush! Gulls dive across the lot!
content.event.lunch-rush.name: Lunch Rush
content.event.strike.announce: Strike! Bowling balls roll in from every side!
content.event.strike.name: Strike
content.item.all-seeing-spud.desc: 35% of kills send 4 potato eyes that pierce through enemies.
content.item.all-seeing-spud.name: All-Seeing Spud
content.item.baked-buckler.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit. Stronger enemies get through more.
content.item.baked-buckler.name: Baked Buckler
content.item.bonfire-spud.desc: 25% of hits set enemies on fire, and the fire spreads to the enemies around them.
content.item.bonfire-spud.name: Bonfire Spud
content.item.boom-spud.name: Boom Spud
content.item.boss-buster.name: Boss Buster
content.item.chive-charm.name: Chive Charm
content.item.coal-baked-spud.desc: 15% of hits set enemies on fire.
content.item.coal-baked-spud.name: Coal-Baked Spud
content.item.compost-tea.name: Compost Tea
content.item.copper-spoon.name: Copper Spoon
content.item.coupon-book.name: Coupon Book
content.item.crit-chip.name: Crit Chip
content.item.cursed-crown.name: Cursed Crown
content.item.extra-eye.name: Extra Eye
content.item.freezer-burn.desc: Frozen enemies shatter when they die and freeze enemies nearby.
content.item.freezer-burn.name: Freezer Burn
content.item.fry-volcano.desc: When Tibo is hit, he erupts in a blast and fires 24 fries that pierce through enemies.
content.item.fry-volcano.name: Fry Volcano
content.item.ghost-pepper.desc: Tibo stays untouchable for 0.15 s after each dash ends.
content.item.ghost-pepper.name: Ghost Pepper
content.item.ghost-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit. The higher your dodge chance, the less it adds.
content.item.ghost-skin.name: Ghost Skin
content.item.glacier-spud.desc: 30% of kills shatter, freezing nearby enemies and slowing the enemies around them.
content.item.glacier-spud.name: Glacier Spud
content.item.golden-gravy.name: Golden Gravy
content.item.heavy-russet.name: Heavy Russet
content.item.hot-pepper.desc: Raises crit chance. The higher your crit chance, the less it adds.
content.item.hot-pepper.name: Hot Pepper
content.item.kaboom-spud.desc: 25% of kills explode, hitting nearby enemies for half the dead enemy's max HP.
content.item.kaboom-spud.name: Kaboom Spud
content.item.lucky-peel.name: Lucky Peel
content.item.magma-croquette.desc: 20% of hits erupt in a huge blast that sets enemies on fire.
content.item.magma-croquette.name: Magma Croquette
content.item.meteor-russet.desc: 3% of hits call down a meteor for 20× damage that also craters enemies around it.
content.item.meteor-russet.name: Meteor Russet
content.item.penny-spud.name: Penny Spud
content.item.philosophers-potato.desc: +10% to damage, area, speed and duration.
content.item.philosophers-potato.name: Philosopher's Potato
content.item.pickle-jar.name: Pickle Jar
content.item.porcupine-spud.desc: When Tibo is hit, he fires 10 fries outward.
content.item.porcupine-spud.name: Porcupine Spud
content.item.salt-crystal.name: Salt Crystal
content.item.second-spud.name: Second Spud
content.item.sharp-peeler.name: Sharp Peeler
content.item.spicy-croquette.desc: 12% of hits burst in a fiery blast.
content.item.spicy-croquette.name: Spicy Croquette
content.item.spud-muffin.name: Spud Muffin
content.item.starch-sock.name: Starch Sock
content.item.static-tot.desc: 10% of hits arc lightning to 3 more enemies.
content.item.static-tot.name: Static Tot
content.item.storm-tot.desc: 15% of hits arc lightning to 6 more enemies, with a thunderclap at each one.
content.item.storm-tot.name: Storm Tot
content.item.thorny-jacket.desc: Enemies that hit Tibo take 8 damage.
content.item.thorny-jacket.name: Thorny Jacket
content.item.time-tuber.name: Time Tuber
content.item.vampire-tot.name: Vampire Tot
content.item.wandering-eyes.desc: 20% of kills send 2 potato eyes after other enemies.
content.item.wandering-eyes.name: Wandering Eyes
content.item.wide-ladle.name: Wide Ladle
content.passive.bacon-bits.desc: +12% damage to elites and bosses per level.
content.passive.bacon-bits.name: Bacon Bits
content.passive.big-bowl.name: Big Bowl
content.passive.butter-pat.name: Butter Pat
content.passive.butter-socks.desc: +1 dash charge at levels 1, 3 and 5. Each level cuts the dash cooldown by 6%.
content.passive.butter-socks.name: Butter Socks
content.passive.chives.name: Chives
content.passive.fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
content.passive.four-eyed-spud.name: Four-Eyed Spud
content.passive.golden-fry.name: Golden Fry
content.passive.gpu.desc: +1 projectile. Firing builds heat. At full heat, weapons fire at half speed for 3s. Each level adds fire rate and cooling.
content.passive.gpu.name: GPU
content.passive.gravy-heart.name: Gravy Heart
content.passive.hot-sauce.desc: Raises crit chance with each level. The higher your crit chance, the less each level adds.
content.passive.hot-sauce.name: Hot Sauce
content.passive.masher-grip.name: Masher Grip
content.passive.potato-magnet.name: Potato Magnet
content.passive.root-network.name: Root Network
content.passive.rotten-spud.desc: +10% curse per level: stronger, faster, more enemies, but more XP and gold.
content.passive.rotten-spud.name: Rotten Spud
content.passive.salt-shaker.name: Salt Shaker
content.passive.slow-cooker.name: Slow Cooker
content.passive.sour-cream.name: Sour Cream
content.passive.sprouting-eyes.name: Sprouting Eyes
content.passive.spud-sneakers.name: Spud Sneakers
content.passive.starch-plating.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit, more with each level. Stronger enemies get through more.
content.passive.starch-plating.name: Starch Plating
content.passive.thick-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit with each level. The higher your dodge chance, the less each level adds.
content.passive.thick-skin.name: Thick Skin
content.poi.bossLair.desc: A boss sleeps here. It guards a big chest.
content.poi.bossLair.name: Boss Lair
content.poi.botDock.desc: Stand by it to call a swarm of Grok Bots.
content.poi.botDock.name: Bot Dock
content.poi.chargeShrine.desc: Stand inside to charge it, then pick a stat.
content.poi.chargeShrine.name: Spud Shrine
content.poi.crops.desc: Break it for gold and a snack.
content.poi.crops.name: Crop Patch
content.poi.curseShrine.desc: Take curse for a pile of gold. Curses bring extra elites and bosses.
content.poi.curseShrine.name: Moldy Shrine
content.poi.dinnerBell.desc: Ring it to call a ring of pests. They drop triple XP.
content.poi.dinnerBell.name: Dinner Bell
content.poi.dog.desc: A good dog looking for a friend. Walk up to it.
content.poi.dog.name: Stray Dog
content.poi.dogKennel.desc: Stand by it to buy up to three levels for your dogs.
content.poi.dogKennel.name: Dog Kennel
content.poi.eliteNest.desc: An elite waits here. It drops a chest.
content.poi.eliteNest.name: Beetle Nest
content.poi.frenzyFryer.desc: Stand by it for a 20 s frenzy.
content.poi.frenzyFryer.name: Frenzy Fryer
content.poi.goldenShrine.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then pick a big blessing.
content.poi.goldenShrine.name: Golden Spud Shrine
content.poi.microwave.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then copy one of your items. The copy melts another item of the same rarity.
content.poi.microwave.name: Microwave
content.poi.paidChest.desc: Costs gold. Holds an item. Each crate costs more than the last.
content.poi.paidChest.name: Potato Crate
content.poi.rootTunnel.desc: Stand by it to tunnel to a far place.
content.poi.rootTunnel.name: Root Tunnel
content.poi.seedVault.desc: Stand by it to charge it for rerolls, a skip and a banish.
content.poi.seedVault.name: Seed Vault
content.poi.spudFreezer.desc: Stand by it to freeze every enemy on the map for 7.5 s. Bosses only slow down.
content.poi.spudFreezer.name: Spud Freezer
content.poi.taterLantern.name: Tater Lantern
content.poi.taterMagnet.desc: Stand by it to pull in every gem and coin.
content.poi.taterMagnet.name: Tater Magnet
content.poi.taterSlots.desc: Pay gold to spin. Match two for an item.
content.poi.taterSlots.name: Tater Slots
content.poi.vendor.name: Fry Cart
content.poi.whetstone.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then level up one of your weapons.
content.poi.whetstone.name: Spud Whetstone

content.weapon.big-fry.desc: The fry pierces everything and grows bigger as it grows stronger.
content.weapon.big-fry.name: Big Fry
content.weapon.bottomless-sack.desc: Pulls two snacks at a time, and they come out evolved.
content.weapon.bottomless-sack.name: Bottomless Sack
content.weapon.butter-streak.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of melted butter that slows pests and burns them for 2 s. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked.
content.weapon.butter-streak.name: Butter Streak
content.weapon.cast-iron.desc: Swings both ways. Swatted bullets hit harder, pierce, and home in on pests. Each elite kill charges the next swing.
content.weapon.cast-iron.name: Cast Iron
content.weapon.chip-shuriken.name: Chip Shuriken
content.weapon.cold-storage.desc: A wider, colder ring. Pests freeze longer and take harder frostbite.
content.weapon.cold-storage.name: Cold Storage
content.weapon.deep-fryer.desc: Sprays hot oil in a cone.
content.weapon.deep-fryer.name: Deep Fryer
content.weapon.eternal-sprouts.name: Eternal Sprouts
content.weapon.factory-reset.desc: A full reset. Clears the screen, keeps the drops, heals Tibo.
content.weapon.factory-reset.name: Factory Reset
content.weapon.frozen-fries.desc: Shoots frozen fries that freeze enemies in place.
content.weapon.frozen-fries.name: Frozen Fries
content.weapon.fry-brigade.desc: Tot pups in fry-cook hats follow Tibo, shoot, and plant fry turrets as they go. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.fry-brigade.name: Fry Brigade
content.weapon.fry-knives.desc: Fires sharp fries in the direction Tibo faces.
content.weapon.fry-knives.name: Fry Knives
content.weapon.fry-lance.desc: One very long fry that pierces a whole line.
content.weapon.fry-lance.name: Fry Lance
content.weapon.fry-sentry.desc: Drops a fry-cook turret that shoots nearby enemies.
content.weapon.fry-sentry.name: Fry Cook Sentry
content.weapon.frying-pan.desc: Swings a pan in front of Tibo. Enemy bullets it swats fly back at whoever shot them. Each elite Tibo kills charges the next swing bigger and harder.
content.weapon.frying-pan.name: Frying Pan
content.weapon.ghee-glide.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of hot ghee that slows and burns pests. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked. Tibo walks 15% faster on the ghee.
content.weapon.ghee-glide.name: Ghee Glide
content.weapon.golden-harvest.desc: A downpour of golden potatoes. Kills can drop gold.
content.weapon.golden-harvest.name: Golden Harvest
content.weapon.grab-bag.desc: Reaches into a sack and fires a different weapon's attack every time.
content.weapon.grab-bag.name: Grab Bag
content.weapon.gratin-arc.desc: A cheesy arc that chains far and crits often.
content.weapon.gratin-arc.name: Gratin Arc
content.weapon.gravy-boat.desc: Pours scalding gravy pools on enemies.
content.weapon.gravy-boat.name: Gravy Boat
content.weapon.gravy-flood.desc: Gravy pools grow and drift after Tibo.
content.weapon.gravy-flood.name: Gravy Flood
content.weapon.hash-boomerang.desc: A crispy hash brown that flies out and comes back.
content.weapon.hash-boomerang.name: Hash Boomerang
content.weapon.hash-brown-shield.desc: Hash browns circle Tibo. Each takes up to 20 damage of one hit or bullet, then bursts into shards that hurt nearby enemies. Thorns add to shard damage. Broken ones re-crisp one at a time.
content.weapon.hash-brown-shield.name: Hash Brown Shield
content.weapon.hash-bulwark.desc: More hash browns that re-crisp faster and take up to 30 damage of a hit. Their shards hit harder and freeze enemies.
content.weapon.hash-bulwark.name: Hash Bulwark
content.weapon.hashnado.desc: Hash browns spin out in a crispy storm and return.
content.weapon.hashnado.name: Hashnado
content.weapon.hot-potato.desc: Hops from pest to pest and blows up on the last one when its count runs out.
content.weapon.hot-potato.name: Hot Potato
content.weapon.inferno-basket.desc: A long blast of fryer oil. Double damage to elites and bosses.
content.weapon.inferno-basket.name: Inferno Basket
content.weapon.julienne-dash.desc: Each dash slices every pest along Tibo's path. Between dashes, it also slices along the path he just walked.
content.weapon.julienne-dash.name: Julienne Dash
content.weapon.kettle-cyclone.name: Kettle Cyclone
content.weapon.landmine-harvest.desc: Rotten mines. Enemies they kill drop extra gold.
content.weapon.landmine-harvest.name: Landmine Harvest
content.weapon.loaded-dice.desc: Rolls two dice and keeps the higher. A pair doubles the throw.
content.weapon.loaded-dice.name: Loaded Dice
content.weapon.mandoline-fury.desc: Slices both ways at once and flings potato slices through the crowd. Each slash hit heals Tibo a little.
content.weapon.mandoline-fury.name: Mandoline Fury
content.weapon.mash-wave.desc: A ring of mashed potato rolls out from Tibo.
content.weapon.mash-wave.name: Mash Wave
content.weapon.mashquake.desc: Mash rolls out in waves that slow what they hit. Each wave flings clumps of mash across the field.
content.weapon.mashquake.name: Mashquake
content.weapon.mezzaluna.desc: Chops in front of Tibo and behind him. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.
content.weapon.mezzaluna.name: Mezzaluna
content.weapon.moon-cleaver.desc: Chops twice in front and once behind, and flicks hash shreds back through the crowd. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.
content.weapon.moon-cleaver.name: Moon Cleaver
content.weapon.overgrowth.desc: Seeker sprouts that split when they hit.
content.weapon.overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
content.weapon.peeler.desc: Slashes sideways. From level 4 it flings potato peels through the crowd, one more each level. Tibo's trusty kitchen tool.
content.weapon.peeler.name: Peeler
content.weapon.permafrost-fries.desc: Freezes longer. Frozen enemies take double damage.
content.weapon.permafrost-fries.name: Permafrost Fries
content.weapon.potato-battery.desc: Clips a live wire onto a pest. The wire zaps and slows every pest it touches. The clipped pest can't die until the wire lets go.
content.weapon.potato-battery.name: Potato Battery
content.weapon.potato-rain.desc: Calls down a shower of potatoes around Tibo.
content.weapon.potato-rain.name: Potato Rain
content.weapon.pressure-cooker.desc: A huge steam cloud. Each enemy it burns heals Tibo.
content.weapon.pressure-cooker.name: Pressure Cooker
content.weapon.railfry.desc: Three lances that cross the whole view.
content.weapon.railfry.name: Railfry
content.weapon.reset-button.desc: We reset the limits. Clears every enemy on screen. Bosses only flinch.
content.weapon.reset-button.name: Reset Button
content.weapon.root-cellar.desc: A ring of cellar cold around Tibo. Pests that cross it take frostbite and freeze for a moment. Bosses only slow.
content.weapon.root-cellar.name: Root Cellar
content.weapon.root-spikes.desc: Roots burst out of the ground under enemies.
content.weapon.root-spikes.name: Root Spikes
content.weapon.rosti-disc.desc: A flat rösti that bounces off the edges of the view.
content.weapon.rosti-disc.name: Rösti Disc
content.weapon.rosti-storm.desc: Bouncing röstis that burst at every bounce.
content.weapon.rosti-storm.name: Rösti Storm
content.weapon.sack-of-russets.desc: A whole sack of heavy potatoes, all at once.
content.weapon.sack-of-russets.name: Sack of Russets
content.weapon.salt-flats.desc: A wider salt trail that slows pests harder and pushes them out of Tibo's path.
content.weapon.salt-flats.name: Salt Flats
content.weapon.salt-line.desc: Tibo trails salt while he walks. Pests on the salt are slowed and stung.
content.weapon.salt-line.name: Salt Line
content.weapon.seeker-sprouts.name: Seeker Sprouts
content.weapon.small-fry.desc: A tiny fry that starts weak and gains damage with every kill it makes, for the rest of the run.
content.weapon.small-fry.name: Small Fry
content.weapon.spicy-hot-potato.desc: Hops further, and its blast throws two fresh hot potatoes.
content.weapon.spicy-hot-potato.name: Spicy Hot Potato
content.weapon.sprout-satellites.desc: Potato sprouts circle Tibo for a while.
content.weapon.sprout-satellites.name: Sprout Satellites
content.weapon.spud-artillery.desc: A barrage of lobbed potatoes that explode. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.spud-artillery.name: Spud Artillery
content.weapon.spud-cannon.desc: A classic potato gun. Shots burst on impact.
content.weapon.spud-cannon.name: Spud Cannon
content.weapon.spud-dice.desc: Throws a potato die. 1 is a dud, 2 freezes, 3 burns, 4 splits, 5 pays gold, 6 blows up big.
content.weapon.spud-dice.name: Spud Dice
content.weapon.spud-grid.desc: Clips three live wires at once. Each wire zaps harder and bursts when it lets go.
content.weapon.spud-grid.name: Spud Grid
content.weapon.spud-lob.desc: Lobs heavy potatoes high. They crash down through crowds.
content.weapon.spud-lob.name: Spud Lob
content.weapon.spudzooka.desc: Big potato rockets that split into cluster bursts.
content.weapon.spudzooka.name: Spudzooka
content.weapon.stand-mixer.desc: Two whirlpools pull harder. When one ends, it slams its catch together.
content.weapon.stand-mixer.name: Stand Mixer
content.weapon.starch-bolt.desc: Static from a pile of starch strikes random enemies.
content.weapon.starch-bolt.name: Starch Bolt
content.weapon.starch-chain.desc: A spark that jumps from enemy to enemy.
content.weapon.starch-chain.name: Starch Chain
content.weapon.starch-supercell.desc: Lightning that chains between enemies. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.starch-supercell.name: Starch Supercell
content.weapon.steam-vent.desc: Hot steam from a baked potato hurts everything close.
content.weapon.steam-vent.name: Steam Vent
content.weapon.taproot-eruption.desc: Giant roots erupt and throw enemies back.
content.weapon.taproot-eruption.name: Taproot Eruption
content.weapon.tater-mines.desc: Buries spuds that burst when enemies step close.
content.weapon.tater-mines.name: Tater Mines
content.weapon.tater-pup.desc: A loyal tot that follows Tibo and shoots.
content.weapon.tater-pup.name: Tater Tot Pup
content.weapon.thousand-fries.name: Thousand Fries
content.weapon.thunder-tuber.name: Thunder Tuber
content.weapon.tot-gatling.desc: A nonstop stream of tater tots.
content.weapon.tot-gatling.name: Tot Gatling
content.weapon.tot-toss.desc: Throws tater tots at the nearest enemy.
content.weapon.tot-toss.name: Tot Toss
content.weapon.waffle-cut.desc: Each dash cuts a cross through every pest along Tibo's path, then cuts it twice more, 0.5 s apart. Between dashes, it also cuts along the path he just walked.
content.weapon.waffle-cut.name: Waffle Cut
content.weapon.whisk-vortex.desc: Spins a whisk whirlpool under the biggest crowd and drags pests into it.
content.weapon.whisk-vortex.name: Whisk Vortex
